Root cause: NoSQL injection in `search` argument of GraphQL endpoint POST /api/users. The `search` value is a raw MongoDB-style filter; the default filter `{"email":{"$regex":".*@heytheregotrythis.com"},"is_admin":false}` hides admins. Sending `search: "{\"is_admin\": true}"` returned the admin users (admin, admin2). Querying all users plus the previously-hidden `flag` field on UserType: `{ users(search: "{}", options: "{\"skip\":0,\"limit\":1000}") { username email flag } }` returned admin2 with flag set. The flag was present on admin2, whose email domain is goodyoutriedsomethingelse.com, matching the hint "try to view the admin of the domain or maybe domains...".
